text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SLO violation detected: p99 latency spike on continuous-batching path for /v1/streaming in us-west-2. p95=420ms, p99=1.82s, SLO p99=1.0s. Trigger: 5m rolling window. Paging eng-oncall.

alex: ack. I can take initial triage, pulling traces and scheduler metrics.

riley: customer-facing support thread shows intermittent stalls, connection stays open but tokens stall ~1.5-2s. low QPS per tenant.

maria: grabbing Datadog query for batcher queue length and per-batch seqlen distribution.

alex: landing traces — looks like KV cache eviction + large mixed-seqlen batches causing pack-shed stalls. A few batches with size=64 contain one request with seqlen=10240 causing packing/overflow.

jamie: ugh mixed sequence length again. Any recent rollout to batcher or scheduler?

alex: No recent code deploys, but there was a config push to increase max_batch_ms from 15->25 on 3076542000 to improve throughput. Could be related.

maria: Datadog snippet: ```
# Batcher metrics
sum:batcher.batches{env:prod,region:usw2}.rollup(sum, 60)
max:batcher.batch_size{env:prod,region:usw2}.rollup(max, 60)
histogram:requests.seqlen{env:prod,region:usw2}.rollup(percentile, 60)
```
observed: 30% of batches now include >1 request with seqlen>4000. tail is heavy.

riley: Customer impact: 3 paying customers in us-west-2 reported degraded UX. One on paged transcripts (long context). Low % but high visibility.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) immediate live mitigation -> reduce max_batch_ms back to 15 to cut packing time 2) enable preemptive-shed for heterolen batches 3) temporary sched fairness tweak to prefer short-requests first.

jamie: agree. I can flip max_batch_ms and enable the shed rule. Will run commands below.

jamie: runbook snippets: ```
# set config via runtime-config service
rcctl set continuous_batch.max_batch_ms 15 --env=prod --region=usw2
# enable heterolen shedding
rcctl set continuous_batch.shed_heterolen true --env=prod --region=usw2
# set scheduling policy
rcctl set scheduler.fairness_mode "short-first" --env=prod --region=usw2
```

sre-ops-bot: :gear: Deploying runtime config change: change_id=cfg-3076543221 user=jamie targeting cb-prod-usw2-*-node. Rolling 50% -> 100% (5m window).

alex: monitoring logs/traces during rollout. Watch for increased tail or dropped requests.

maria: Started dashboard watch: batcher queue length, per-batch worst seqlen, streaming token latency. Setting alert to 10% reduction target on p99.

jamie: config change applied to 50% hosts. Rolling to remaining nodes.

sre-ops-bot: :white_check_mark: 100% config rollout complete (cfg-3076543221). No config errors.

alex: early signal looks good — p99 down from 1.82s -> 1.05s in 10m window. p95 stable. Still above target slightly.

riley: I've notified support and CS: told them mitigation in progress, likely resolved in ~15m. Asked to collect any repros.

maria: digging further: a subset of tenants still show micro-stalls — looks correlated with KV sharding hotspots causing cache evictions at batch boundaries. When packer sees a huge seqlen in batch it forces kernel path that blocks small requests behind it.

alex: ok next step: schedule a hotfix to add two immediate heuristics: 1) soft cap on per-batch max tokens (reject/move very-large into single-request batches) 2) early preempt if batch contains >1 request with seqlen>threshold.

jamie: can implement config-based heuristics quickly: ```
rcctl set continuous_batch.max_tokens_per_batch 12000 --env=prod --region=usw2
rcctl set continuous_batch.heterolen_preempt_count 1 --env=prod --region=usw2
```

jamie: applying heuristics now as config flags (non-code path).

sre-ops-bot: :gear: Deploying config: change_id=cfg-3076543310 user=jamie. Rolling 30% -> 100%.

maria: post-heuristics metric: p99 dropped to 0.82s, p95 380ms. Stalls no longer visible in streaming traces.

alex: good. Please keep watch for 1h. We'll keep this thread open for handoff.

riley: Customers okayed temporary mitigation; CS to follow up with postmortem note.

jamie: logging a follow-up ticket for code fix (pack-safe scheduling + explicit large-request path) — ISSUE-1213 assigned to eng-runtime.

alex: handoff to night oncall in 40m. @oncall-bot schedule page for followup if p99 > 1.0s for next 1h.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Watch configured: if p99 >= 1.0s over 10m window, page @eng-oncall. Watch expires 60m from now.

sre-ops-bot: :memo: Incident summary: cont-batch heterolen packing + increased max_batch_ms (config push) led to mixed batches with giant seqlen causing tail latency. Live mitigations: reverted max_batch_ms, enabled heterolen_shed, set fairness short-first, applied heuristic caps. Customer impact: small subset of customers experienced streaming stalls, no data loss. Next: code PR to add pack-safe scheduling, e2e test for mixed-seqlen.

alex: thanks team. tagging for postmortem: @maria to own metrics section, @jamie to own mitigation timeline, @alex to own RCA. Closing active paging.

riley: :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: :heavy_check_mark: Paging closed. Root cause investigation ticket created ISSUE-1213.
